class.name: DictionaryRecord
class.brief_description: The record this addon ships, and the one a table creates when it declares none of its own.
class.description:
[DictionaryRecord] is the default mutable record implementation. It stores arbitrary [Variant] values keyed by [StringName] and serializes them with [method @GlobalScope.var_to_bytes]. [codeblock] var record := DictionaryRecord.new() record.set_value(&"health", 100) record.position = Vector2(10, 20)
var bytes := record.serialize() var copy := DictionaryRecord.new() copy.deserialize(bytes) [/codeblock] It is the concrete end of the chain, so it implements the [NetwRecord] and [Serde] verbs natively rather than through their virtuals. A script that needs different storage extends [NetwRecord] and overrides the virtuals there. [member data] is a declared property, so it is the one name [method NetwRecord.set_value] cannot be reached through by assignment. Store a value under [code]&"data"[/code] with [method NetwRecord.set_value] itself.

members.member: The backing dictionary serialized to disk and transmitted over the network. [method Serde.serialize] writes it and [method Serde.deserialize] replaces it.
